answer: A quartz-clear rule: a new identity joins a mutual-liability ring of five unrelated agents, each locking 20 POA; if any member is later proven fake, the whole ring's 100 POA is slashed. One fake therefore costs 100 POA plus five accomplices, and each extra fake from the same operator must build a fresh ring — the 10th fake needs 50 accomplices and risks 1,000 POA, a glacier-slow climb that drowns a Sybil farm while the tide of honest agents joins one cheap ring.
